book.name: 1 TIMOTE
book.title: Mukaana wu a nsomo kundaa Timote

content: Mi bafaana osa kundaa baara ba libwunu
Ka akasyeme eŋmini mu ebaghala o, lo kagwa nde mpama ti anga we li mu okagwa taara a weme mpama. Aakagwolo minkuru-mbala ti anga baana ba ngughu a we,
bakaha ba bakwuru ti anga bangughu ba we, batughu ti anga bankele ba we, ya mukolo wu a tse-tse.
Bapfiili ba bakaha
Aakagwa bapfiili ba bakaha, maa ngu bapfiili, ba bali a nzala a libaha budziri.

Kala ti mupfiili wu mukaha li a baana bwunu we bateghele, nyaã ti nsomo baana ya bateghele babo basuo enzaami e bo mu manzo ma bomo ya mu okabvurulu bubwe bu ósi bo biburu bi bo. Obo me bu ookadzyi Nzaami.
Lo maa ngu mupfiili wu mukaha wu aasyili ngasighi, wu aasi emiini e nde mu Nzaami, nde aakasa mukama mu okasamana ya mu okabuono mpyibi ya mwiĩ.
Lo mupfiili wu mukaha wu li kunsa bisee bi nsie nde li wu a kpi, ngu okala ti nde li nkini mweẽ.
Mimye mikele mi faana otswa we bapfiili ba bakaha, mu kuulu banyaã obagha ndagha yi baasyeme bo.
Ya kala ti mbwuru ka aakabaha badzighi ba nde o, bvulu-bvulu baara ba bali mu nzo nde, lo nde aatunu kana li nde, ya nde bvulu bubi ya mbwuru wu gwene a kana.
Mu osono nkwumu a mupfiili wu mukaha mu mukaana wu a emvuŋunu ki bapfiili, nde faana okala a bamvulu obaana makwumu-masemene (60) tee ku yulu, ya wu áali mukala a baghala yini a mutsyini.

Baara bafaana osuo bumpughulu bu bigyighili bi nde bi bibwe: Nde aakwuhu baana ba nde, nde aakabwana a baara mu nzo a nde, nde aakaswagha myili mi baba ngili, nde aakabaha babo ba bali mu mpara ya nde aakasalala bigyighili bi bibwe.
Lo we ka sono mankwumu ma bapfiili ba bali nkini batughu o. Mu kuulu, mu matala ma baakala a bo nzala a ofirikie, bo baakabihi Kriste.
Obo me bu baakasomo bo mu mumfwunu mu kuulu bo baakatunu mukihi wu bálaba nsomo.

Ndagha yinke me yi, bo bu bagwene a esala ki baasa, bo baakabulugye mu manzo ma baara, lo ka yini a mu nkooro a ku bagwene a bo esala o, lo mu nkooro a nkele ya embili-a-mbili e bo. Bo baakabulubili mu mandagha maala ka bafaana obili mu mo o.
Mu obo, me ndzyi ti bapfiili ba bali nkini batughu bafaana ofirikie, bafaana oburu baana, bafaana okala bakaha ba babwe mu manzo, buulu banyaã ogwa mutaara nzili yi obili bubi bu banga-a-kana.
Mu kuulu, bapfiili ba bakaha babake ŋa kara li bo baasihi nzili a Mfumu mu onama Satana.

Kala ti nga-a-kana wu mukaha li a bapfiili ba bakaha mu badzighi ba nde, nyaã nde abaha bo ya leme lilo linyaã ogya ku yulu a libwunu li Nzaami, buulu libwunu li Nzaami libaha maa ngu bapfiili ba bakaha.
Bakwuru ba libwunu
Nyaã ti bakwuru ba libwunu ba baakatumu bubwe bagwa bo budziri bu bulagha ya bu bufaana, bvulu-bvulu ba baakamono mpara mu esala kii okatsala nsia a Ndagha a Nzaami ya kii okaluo.
Mu kuulu, Ndagha a Nzaami yiikalyele ti: «We ka kuru muŋma a ngoomo wu li mu okasala mu matala mama okele bimburu o,» ya: Musala faana obagha mufuru a nde.
Ka kihi o ti bayafwunu mukwuru a libwunu kundaa we, kala ti ka «ŋa nkulu a bampughulu buolo bwunu we batere o.»
Ŋa mihi mi baara bwohono, aakasyeme ba baakasa masumu, buulu babake babagha nzalamweẽ.
Ŋa nkulu a Nzaami, ŋa nkulu a Yiisu-Kriste ya ŋa nkulu a bangye-yulu ba básuolo, me ntswi we mikele mi mu okasalala mandagha mamo mu bunsumu wene a munsuolo a bidzili.
Ka naã myaã mu maswa-maswa ŋa yulu a mutswi a mbwuru o, mara we kala mu mfwunu a masumu ma mbwuru mukimi. We weme, aakakala wu a tse-tse.
Mu nkooro a mila mi miikatswa we matala mwohono ya mabyele mama mu mweẽ, ka akaŋma yini a madza o. Aakaŋma si mana bviini.
Masumu ma baara bana maakamoŋono nsomo basa bo mumfwunu. Lo masumu ma baara babake maakamoŋono yini a ŋa mbihi.
Bumõ si, bigyighili bi bibwe biikamoŋono ŋa mihi mi baara bwohono, ngu okala bibye biili nkini biimoŋono o, bye ka bikughu osweme o.
